title: Participants’ Recruitment and Samples Collection
author: Barbara Rizzacasa
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zpvf5n6

steps.title: Collect blood samples
steps.instruction: Collect 10mL of whole blood in tubes containing K2 EDTA anticoagulant from the following patient groups:

substeps.instruction: Collect from 61 patients with chronic stable coronary artery disease (CAD) at the time of hospitalization.
Collect from 38 patients after a myocardial infarction event (AMI_T0 group) within 24 hours from the onset of the myocardial event.
Collect from 11 patients 6 months post-AMI (AMI_T1 group).

steps.title: Process blood samples
steps.instruction: Process all collected samples within 4 hours of blood withdrawal, maintaining them at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Inspect all samples to exclude the presence of hemolysis and clots before processing.
